text: The source that classifies the 2025 loss area as native forest is the **MGAP forest map 2021** from the Uruguay Ministry of Livestock, Agriculture, and Fisheries. It identifies 13.1 hectares of the 13.5-hectare loss area as native forest, with no planted forest detected. The JRC GFC2020 reference confirms the area was forested in 2020, while Hansen GFC (GFC-2025-v1.13) observed the 2025 tree-cover loss.
